name: XT workstation - Production 230XP22B layout (illustrative)
description: Dynamic subsea producer arranged as on the reference control-system page 'Production 230XP22B': production bore with SCSSV, PMV and the production wing (PWV) ending in the production choke CHK-101; A-annulus with AMV, AWV, crossover XOV into the tree cavity and the annulus service line valve SLV; chemical injection into the production wing; two methanol injection valves either side of PWV; downhole chemical injection; SCM A/B hydraulic headers with selector valves (fail-safe closure on loss of supply). The photograph defines the ARCHITECTURE only: every reading is calculated by the simulator from the configured reservoir, fluid, boundary and valve inputs. All data are ILLUSTRATIVE training values.

integrity_tests.name: PMV inflow (leak-off) test - tree cavity
integrity_tests.description: Close PMV, bleed the cavity to flowline pressure through PWV, close PWV, then monitor PT-104 for build-up from tubing pressure across the closed PMV.

integrity_tests.name: Tree cavity pressure-hold test (MeOH pressurised)
integrity_tests.description: With PMV, PWV and SV closed, pressurise the cavity with methanol (open CIV-301), close CIV-301, then monitor PT-104 for decay across the PMV / PWV / SV seats.

integrity_tests.name: Swab valve inflow test - tree cap
integrity_tests.description: With SV-101 closed and the tree bore at production pressure, monitor the tree cap (PT-105) for build-up across the closed swab valve.

integrity_tests.name: AMV inflow test - annulus cavity
integrity_tests.description: Close AMV, bleed the AMV-AWV cavity through AWV and SLV, close AWV and monitor PT-402.

briefing: This page follows the arrangement of the reference control-system page 'Production 230XP22B', with SubseaSim engineering tags.

Every reading is calculated by the simulator from the inputs on the Conditions page (reservoir pressure, temperature, productivity, fluid, downstream pressure) and the valve positions - change them and watch the transmitters respond.
Try closing PWV-101: the tree cavity (PTT-104 / PTT-107) builds toward shut-in pressure while the choke outlet (PTT-103 / PTT-106) falls toward flowline pressure.
Selector valves route the LP and HP hydraulic supplies to SCM A and B. Close both LP selector valves and watch PT-611 / PT-612 bleed down until the fail-safe valves close.
Open MIV-302 (upstream of PWV) or MIV-303 (between PWV and the choke) to inject methanol into the production stream; the concentration is tracked downstream.
